headline: Northern Fronts Reignite While Western Islands Exchange Key Outposts
war_summary: Battle lines shifted violently across several sectors over the past three hours, led by renewed upheaval in Linn of Mercy, where three strategic base transfers unfolded at Outwich Ranch and Lathair amid over thirteen hundred fresh casualties. Nevish Line sustained intense combat with six base exchanges centered on Tomb Father and Grief Mother, while Fisherman's Row flared suddenly into action with four rapid flips at Oceanwatch. In Weathered Expanse, bitter fighting resumed around Spirit Watch as combined losses surpassed thirty-four hundred men in two hours alone. Callahan's Passage and Dead Lands continued their ferocious meatgrinder attrition without immediate territorial change, the former exacting nearly forty-five hundred casualties in the latest two-hour stretch. In contrast, earlier flashpoints in Farranac Coast, Palantine Berm, and Godcrofts cooled noticeably, recording sharp drops in frontline turnover and reduced casualty tempos.
